v106.scope: Database-level Last-Owner protection constraint trigger (ADMIN_ACTIONS_DESIGN_V1 item 35)
triggers: tr_identity_mfa_last_owner_lock (BEFORE UPDATE Of TwoFactorEnabled on identity."AspNetUsers")
assertions: Database rejects disabling MFA on the last active Owner
Database rejects demoting the last active Owner
Database rejects deactivating the last active Owner
Database rejects removing the last active Owner
Database rejects creating a tenant without an active MFA-enabled Owner
Database permits Owner demotion when another active MFA-enabled Owner remains
Existing tests in Atendee.Identity.Checks verify the constraint
notes: V106 uses advisory lock hash 73190422 (different from V10's 73190421)
Both constraints can coexist; V106 provides additional coverage
Tests use atendee_owner role which has EXECUTE permission on the functions
